traversalRules: Seed every current catalog row and retain every Raw candidate for exact, provisional, ambiguous, and not-found mappings. Never use presentation/icon hints as identity proof.

Starting from every candidate instance, recursively follow serialized local /Game package relations with no fixed-depth cap: import/package, object-property, soft-object-property, export class/super/template/outer, and recorded inheritance-chain edges.

Use each edge sourceOccurrence.propertyPath (or export-table serializedField), occurrence order/index, source/target object and package, class, raw package index, and traversal stopReason. Keep duplicate occurrences and null references.

At every reached package, retain decoded CDO property trees including nested arrays/structs, value/type/decode state, source ranges, plus package exports/references, imports, super/template, payloadCoverage, diagnostics, and unavailable ranges.

Search for timing-like names and relations as discovery hints, not as a closed whitelist. Preserve unknown decoded fields and explicit not-observed/parser-boundary/native/out-of-scope/missing/null states.
Do not convert an unavailable value, empty child list, null relation, missing field, or parser boundary into 0; do not promote a linked display name into a resolved package relation.

parserBoundaries.evidence: Representative Gauntlets AnimComposite and Scatter Crossbow AnimMontage packages expose export names/classes, while payloadCoverage.nonCdoExportsNotDecoded is positive and no timeline CDO properties exist.

parserBoundaries.boundary: partial/unsupported CDO streams and table-like packages
parserBoundaries.evidence: Use manifest.boundaries.parser and each package diagnostics/unavailableRanges/payloadCoverage; relevant item-linked Artifact cases are itemized in artifactCooldownClosure.
Structural Inventory retains export references and marks non-CDO exports not-extracted; it does not decode runtime timer start or state transitions.

empiricalBoundaries: Effective HPS and attack-speed transformation after game input, animation interruption/cancel windows, actual recovery/hitstop, sawblade continuous/release/overheat cycle, and any trigger cadence not represented in decoded static fields. These are measurement requirements, not formula implementations in this audit.

artifactCooldownClosure.classificationBasis: Per-item classification is for the base-cooldown value source after traversing the candidate instance and reachable local /Game package/CDO relation closure. Cooldown-start semantics are recorded as a separate result because the inventory does not decode Blueprint execution payloads.

cooldownStartSemantics.scope: all 45 Artifact rows; recorded separately from baseCooldownClassification
cooldownStartSemantics.observation: The committed structural inventory exposes activation animation/effect/actor relations and decoded CDO properties, but does not decode Blueprint non-CDO execution/function payloads needed to prove when a cooldown timer starts relative to input, effect application, animation notify, or actor spawn.
cooldownStartSemantics.retentionRule: Store the start-semantics state as parser-boundary/not-established with its candidate and relation provenance. Do not infer a start point from ActivationAnimation, Effect, ActorClass, or external published cooldown values.

traversalRules: For every Artifact catalog seed, visit every candidate instance path retained by Raw inventory, including all Fireworks Arrow ambiguous candidates.

From each instance, traverse actual object-property/import/soft-object/export/super/template links into Actor, GameplayEffect, projectile/spawned actor, animation, and inherited packages; retain field paths and serialized relation occurrence rather than imposing a fixed relation taxonomy.

Search decoded CDO trees across the full linked closure for base cooldown and cooldown-start facts. Keep adjacent SharedPassiveCooldown, refund, reduction, or per-pet flags under their original names and owners; never relabel them as base cooldown.

When a linked Actor/GameplayEffect CDO is partial/unsupported, classify that Artifact as parser-boundary and retain the exact package path/relation. If all relevant reached CDOs are decoded and no base field exists, classify it not-observed.
External Wiki/dungeons.tools/database numbers may not fill Raw values or alter these classifications.

decisionRationale: Linked-timing traversal and field-retention rules are fixed with per-category source relations, parser limits, empirical-only behavior, and explicit absence/null/decode states.

Every Artifact catalog row has a retained candidate-path source outcome: base cooldown is parser-boundary for 5 items and not-observed for 40; no published database values are substituted. Cooldown-start semantics are separately explicit as parser-boundary across the static inventory layer.
